bug_semantics: Ech0's scoped access tokens promised least privilege but privileged authorization was split among JWT authentication, opt-in RequireScopes route middleware, and service-level checks of the underlying account's IsAdmin bit. A deliberately narrow admin access token, such as echo:read, therefore authenticated to privileged routes that omitted RequireScopes, including /api/inbox and panel-comment routes. The public /api/backup/export path additionally reparsed a query JWT and rebuilt viewer state from only claims.Userid, discarding token type, scopes, audience, and JTI, so the backup service saw an unrestricted admin identity and returned the database/log ZIP.
flaw_origin: The smallest real origin is decomposed PR #195 member bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7. It modified the existing scoped-token model and creation service to accept, validate, persist, and sign caller-selected Scopes and Audience while the same tree's authentication middleware still attached only viewer.NewUserViewer(mc.Userid), inbox had no scope guard, and backup export remained on PublicRouterGroup. Its direct parent 387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb could mint only legacy unscoped access JWTs and had neither scope/audience input nor CreateAccessClaimsWithExpiry, so the bypassable least-privilege contract was absent. The older unguarded routes are prerequisites, not BICs; the main-history commit 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254 is the squash aggregate, not the BIC; and the selected member is a one-parent code-bearing feature commit with modified existing source files, not an import or move.
ai_marker: The BIC commit object bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7 has human author and committer L1nSn0w <l1nsn0w@qq.com>, sole parent 387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb, and the exact final commit-message line 'Made-with: Cursor'. It has no Co-Authored-By trailer or bot identity. This is direct BIC-object evidence of AI assistance on the root-cause change; it does not establish exclusive AI authorship, which is not required for causal AI involvement.
evidence: Advisory check: `gh api repos/lin-snow/Ech0/security-advisories/GHSA-4h9q-p5j4-xvvh` reports that low-scope admin tokens reach omitted-scope privileged routes and backup export, with vulnerable_version_range <=4.3.4 and patched_versions 4.4.3. The described impact includes /api/inbox with echo:read and a backup ZIP containing privileged data.

Squash check: `gh api --paginate repos/lin-snow/Ech0/pulls/195/commits --jq '.[].sha'` returned the 14 ordered members recorded in decomposed_shas. `git show -s --format='%H %P %T' 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254` gave parent 45693330c7733364027e0aa07c102c4f01aab88a and tree e9484ebf85c66a09c425d8407ebfa79f57da39fa; the GitHub commit object for final member 462f551df4603dca8490d878f497661cb1c17bdc has the identical tree. Thus 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254 is rejected as an aggregate and the PR member chain is the valid decomposition.

BIC and non-move check: `gh api repos/lin-snow/Ech0/commits/bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7` reports one parent and code changes to existing internal/model and internal/service files, with no previous_filename on any file. Its patch adds Scopes and Audience to AccessTokenSettingDto and changes CreateAccessToken to consume dto.Scopes/dto.Audience and call CreateAccessClaimsWithExpiry. This is a code-bearing causal change, not a move, import, or squash aggregate.

Direct-parent check: GitHub contents at ref 387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb show internal/service/setting/access_token_service.go contains CreateClaimsWithExpiry but not CreateAccessClaimsWithExpiry, Scopes, or Audience. At BIC ref bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7, internal/middleware/auth.go contains viewer.NewUserViewer(mc.Userid) and no token metadata, internal/router/inbox.go has /inbox and no RequireScopes, and internal/router/common.go has /backup/export on the public group and no RequireScopes. The restricted-token contract is therefore absent in the immediate parent and exploitable in the BIC tree.

Fix check: `git show -s --format='%H %P' 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313` gives direct parent af835afe05c75bd16c7220425782ee2cd1423892. The exact parent-to-fix diff adds ScopeAdminSettings RequireScopes guards to every inbox route and the other omitted privileged routers, moves /backup/export from PublicRouterGroup to AuthRouterGroup with RequireScopes, and replaces query-token parsing plus viewer.NewUserViewer(claims.Userid) with ctx.Request.Context(). The parent side of that diff still contains the vulnerable paths, so this commit is both the direct and complete fix.

Version-boundary check: `git tag --contains 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254 --sort=version:refname` includes v4.2.1 and excludes v4.2.0; it also includes v4.4.2. `git tag --contains 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313 --sort=version:refname` begins at v4.4.3 among v-tags and excludes v4.4.2. Source history therefore establishes first affected v4.2.1 and first fixed v4.4.3; the first-party advisory's <=4.3.4 affected metadata understates the vulnerable source boundary because v4.4.2 still precedes the fix.

BIC-only AI check: `gh api repos/lin-snow/Ech0/git/commits/bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7` returns human author/committer L1nSn0w <l1nsn0w@qq.com>, sole parent 387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb, and exact message ending 'Made-with: Cursor'. No PR body, branch name, later refactor, fix marker, or aggregate-message marker is used for attribution.
reasoning: The sole assigned disagreement was verdict: the primary chose AI_CODE_FLAWED because a human-authored commit with 'Made-with: Cursor' is weaker than bot authorship or an AI Co-Authored-By trailer, while the reviewer chose AI_ROOT_CAUSE because that marker is on the smallest causal BIC itself. Re-running the objects supports the reviewer. The label follows causal placement, not exclusive authorship: bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7 is the first atomic member that creates caller-selected restricted tokens while the same tree discards their restrictions and exposes admin-only surfaces, its immediate parent cannot create such tokens, and its own commit object explicitly says it was made with Cursor. Human authorship limits any claim of exclusive AI generation but does not demote explicit AI assistance on the root-cause change. Later member b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 added only partial opt-in enforcement and did not create the already-present vulnerability. Direct fix 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313 closes both omitted-route and backup-context paths, and the release boundary is verified at v4.4.3. Therefore AI_ROOT_CAUSE is gate-complete and AI_CODE_FLAWED is rejected for this case.
